title: Mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn, all of whom, which
summary: Rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ bằng V-ing/V3, dùng giới từ + whom/which, some of which, và which thay cả câu.

dialogue.en: Who is the man [[standing]] by the door?
dialogue.vi: Người đàn ông đứng cạnh cửa là ai?

dialogue.en: That's Mr. Hai, the manager [[to whom]] I sent my CV.
dialogue.vi: Đó là anh Hải, quản lý mà mình gửi CV.

dialogue.en: He interviewed five people, [[all of whom]] were nervous.
dialogue.vi: Anh ấy phỏng vấn năm người, ai cũng run.

dialogue.en: I got the job, [[which]] surprised everyone.
dialogue.vi: Mình được nhận, điều đó làm mọi người bất ngờ.

dialogue.en: Congratulations! Is it the company [[founded]] by his father?
dialogue.vi: Chúc mừng! Có phải công ty do bố anh ấy lập không?

sections.heading: Bỏ who/which + be: V-ing và V3
sections.rule: **who/which + is/are + V-ing** → **V-ing**; **who/which + is/was + V3** → **V3**. Cũng rút gọn **who + V** chủ động thành **V-ing**.

examples.en: The girl [[sitting]] next to me is my cousin.
examples.vi: Cô gái ngồi cạnh tôi là em họ tôi.

examples.en: The cars [[made]] in this factory are cheap.
examples.vi: Ô tô làm ở nhà máy này rẻ.

examples.en: People [[living]] near the river worry about floods.
examples.vi: Người sống gần sông lo lũ lụt.

check.prompt: The woman ___ the red dress is my boss.
check.explain: Chủ động → V-ing (= who is wearing).

sections.heading: The person to whom…, the house in which…
sections.rule: Văn trang trọng đưa **giới từ lên trước whom / which**. Văn nói để giới từ ở cuối: *the person I spoke to*.

examples.en: The man [[to whom]] I spoke was very kind.
examples.vi: Người đàn ông mà tôi nói chuyện rất tốt bụng.

examples.en: This is the house [[in which]] I grew up.
examples.vi: Đây là ngôi nhà nơi tôi lớn lên.

examples.en: The man I spoke [[to]] was very kind.
examples.vi: Người tôi nói chuyện rất tốt bụng.
examples.why: Văn nói: giới từ ở cuối.

check.prompt: The company for ___ she works is in Hanoi.
check.explain: Sau giới từ dùng which (không dùng that).

sections.heading: All of whom, some of which, which (cả câu)
sections.rule: **all / some / many / none of + whom / which** nói một phần nhóm. **, which** có thể chỉ **cả mệnh đề trước**.

examples.en: I have two brothers, [[both of whom]] live abroad.
examples.vi: Tôi có hai anh trai, cả hai đều sống ở nước ngoài.

examples.en: She bought ten books, [[some of which]] were old.
examples.vi: Cô ấy mua mười cuốn sách, vài cuốn cũ.

examples.en: He passed the exam, [[which]] surprised us.
examples.vi: Cậu ấy đỗ, điều đó làm chúng tôi bất ngờ.

check.prompt: There were 30 students, most of ___ were from Hanoi.
check.explain: Most of whom (người, sau giới từ).

mistakes.wrong: The man who sitting there is my uncle.
mistakes.right: The man sitting there is my uncle.

mistakes.wrong: The house in that I live is old.
mistakes.right: The house in which I live is old.
mistakes.why: Sau giới từ không dùng that.

mistakes.wrong: I have two sisters, both of them live in Hue.
mistakes.right: I have two sisters, both of whom live in Hue.
mistakes.why: Nối hai mệnh đề → both of whom.

mistakes.wrong: He failed the test, that made him sad.
mistakes.right: He failed the test, which made him sad.
mistakes.why: Chỉ cả câu → which, không dùng that.

mistakes.wrong: The products making here are sold abroad.
mistakes.right: The products made here are sold abroad.

exercises.prompt: The boy ___ football over there is my son.
The letters ___ by her grandfather are in a box.
This is the friend about ___ I told you.
She has three cats, all of ___ are black.
He arrived two hours late, ___ annoyed everyone.
Anyone ___ to join the club should call Nam.
The rice ___ in this region is famous.
I met many people, some of ___ became good friends.
The town in ___ he was born is very small.

exercises.vi: Người phụ nữ đứng ở cửa là cô giáo tôi.
Tôi có hai con, cả hai đều đi học.

exercises.sentence: The man who wearing a hat is my father.
answers: The man wearing a hat is my father.

exercises.sentence: The city in that she lives is very big.
answers: The city in which she lives is very big.

exercises.sentence: She invited 20 people, most of them came.
answers: She invited 20 people, most of whom came.
exercises.explain: Nối mệnh đề → most of whom.

exercises.vi: Những ngôi nhà xây năm ngoái đã bị bán hết.
answers: The houses built last year have all been sold.
The houses built last year have been sold.
All the houses built last year have been sold.
The houses built last year were all sold.
The houses that were built last year have all been sold.

exercises.vi: Anh ấy quên sinh nhật tôi, điều đó làm tôi buồn.
answers: He forgot my birthday, which made me sad.
He forgot my birthday, which made me upset.
He forgot my birthday, which upset me.
He forgot about my birthday, which made me sad.
He forgot my birthday, which made me unhappy.
